about: Every official game image pingalto shows (owner 2026-11-10: official images from the publisher's own source, unmodified, with the publisher's notice; if a publisher objects, its art is removed). One switch per publisher: set publishers.<id>.enabled to false, rebuild and deploy the site, and sync the pingalto feeds (the clash feed then empties /data/feeds/clash-art/). Files of a set live in its dir (hashed into /s/ by the build) or, for art copied on the server, are listed by the feed in the document it names. robots.txt of each host is read before any download; a 403 is never worked around.

riot.notice: pingalto was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.
riot.policy: brand-policies.json publishers.riot (Legal Jibber Jabber: noncommercial community use of Riot IP; no Riot logos)

valorantapi.notice: pingalto was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project. Valorant images: valorant-api.com, a fan mirror of the original game art.
valorantapi.policy: Fan mirror of original art, owner 2026-11-10 ("official ones or whatever is better"): Riot publishes no open image files for Valorant. robots.txt of valorant-api.com: "Disallow:" for *; media.valorant-api.com: no rules (only Cloudflare content signals, none set). Needs publishers.riot on as well.

supercell.notice: This material is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information see Supercell's Fan Content Policy: www.supercell.com/fan-content-policy.
supercell.policy: brand-policies.json publishers.supercell (Fan Content Policy: fan pages and guide apps; Supercell assets not modified)

brawlify.notice: This material is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information see Supercell's Fan Content Policy: www.supercell.com/fan-content-policy. Brawl Stars images: Brawlify CDN (cdn.brawlify.com), a fan mirror of the original game art.
brawlify.policy: Fan CDN of original art, owner 2026-11-10 ("official ones or whatever is better"): the official API names no images. robots.txt of cdn.brawlify.com: "Disallow:" for *. The Brawlify API answers 403 to us and is not used. Needs publishers.supercell on as well.

sets.what: Square portrait of every League of Legends champion (Data Dragon, the version of the saved champion list), served as WebP 104 px
sets.robots: ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/robots.txt answers 403 (an S3 error page): no rules, RFC 9309

sets.what: Icon of every playable Valorant agent, served as WebP 128 px (the 1024 px originals are about 570 KB)
sets.source: displayIcon of the saved valorant-api.com agent list (media.valorant-api.com/agents/<uuid>/displayicon.png)

sets.what: Banner of every Valorant map with sites, served as WebP 456 px
sets.source: listViewIcon of the saved valorant-api.com map list (media.valorant-api.com/maps/<uuid>/listviewicon.png)

sets.what: In-game minimap of the maps with an interactive callout page (Ascent, Split), WebP 640 px, under the callout dots
sets.source: displayIcon of the saved valorant-api.com map list (media.valorant-api.com/maps/<uuid>/displayicon.png)

sets.what: Icon of each Valorant rank (first division, the latest act of valorant-api.com competitivetiers), WebP 64 px
Card art of every Clash Royale card and its evolution, as named by iconUrls in the official API
sets.server: /data/feeds/clash-art/ on pingalto.com, written by the clash feed (tools/feeds/pingalto/card-art.mjs): WebP tiles 210 px wide derived from the 300 px originals (cwebp), PNG as received when cwebp is missing
sets.robots: api-assets.clashroyale.com/robots.txt answers 404: no rules; the feed reads it before each new download
sets.list: /data/feeds/clash-art.json: every copied file with its source URL and the date it was copied

sets.what: Brawl Stars brawler portraits (borderless), map images of the rotation and of the Argentine battles, game mode icons
sets.server: /data/feeds/brawl-art/ on pingalto.com, written by the brawl feed (tools/feeds/pingalto/brawl-art.mjs); maps as WebP 220 px when cwebp is there
sets.robots: cdn.brawlify.com/robots.txt: "User-agent: * Disallow:" (checked 2026-11-10); the feed reads it before each new download
sets.list: /data/feeds/brawl-art.json: every copied file with its source URL and the date it was copied
sets.note: fan CDN of original art, owner 10.11

notAvailable.valorant: Riot publishes no open image files for Valorant; agent icons and map banners come from valorant-api.com, a fan mirror of the original art (own switch publishers.valorantapi).
notAvailable.valve: Valve publishes no fan-site licence. Dota 2 hero portraits exist on Valve's CDN (robots: none), but no pingalto page lists heroes (OpenDota keeps AI agents out, so there is no hero data); CS2 has no official map or rank image files. No Valve image.
notAvailable.epic: fortnite.com and epicgames.com answer 403 to us: not fetched (brand-policies.json).
notAvailable.logos: Riot forbids its logos without a written licence; the Supercell fan kit answers 403 to us; Garena and EA have no fan policy: no game logos.
notAvailable.lolRanks: LoL rank emblems: Riot publishes them only as a zip for developers; the CommunityDragon mirror has small crests without Emerald and large emblems on 16:9 canvases that would need cropping. Not shown.
notAvailable.teams: Team logos (PandaScore image_url): many teams carry betting sponsors in their logos and the audience is young; names are masked for betting brands, logos cannot be checked the same way. Not shown.
